title: 第1446章 胖毛进阶六阶大妖第1445章 师父你要尽早飞升来找阿瞳哦
lines: 李卓阳游历期间发现，南瞻部洲大陆之中，不少低阶灵脉甚至是已经枯竭的灵脉，都在缓缓地恢复着。
凡人国度中，身怀灵根的少年，也被发现得越来越多。
不少原本只能修炼到炼气境九层的普通国度修仙界中，也渐渐开始有人筑基了。
这些变化，当然令李卓阳感到欣喜。
他甚至还想到，或许南瞻部洲与其他几洲之间的距离，也在缓缓拉近。
某处一座不知名山谷之中，被布置出了一座方圆百丈的巨大法阵。
从高空看去，这座法阵的除了周边大量的阵旗之外，位于中间部位的，竟然是一幅用不知何种材料绘制的图画。
而细细看去，这个图画中所绘制的，竟然是一头融合了凤族五族所有特点的凤族画像。
在法阵周边，则是站着十多位穿着各异的修士。
“青兄，这处法阵，果真能寻到流淌着我凤族血脉的后裔么？”
“要知道，这次各脉凑出的凤族精血，可不在少数，若是最终传送而来的后裔数量不多，或者血脉纯度不足的话，那这次可就算是做了赔本儿买卖了。”
说话之人，乃是一位白袍之人，其说话间，双目之中犹如有雷光闪烁，令人几乎不敢直视其双眸。
“哎，白兄，此言差矣啊……”
那位被称为青兄之人没开口，倒是其身侧的红袍修士，当先答道：“若是将此事当做普通买卖，那着实算不上什么好买卖。”
“毕竟，眼下五洲之中，是否还有凤族血脉后裔，谁也说不准。”
“但是若将此事当做拯救我凤族存续大业之举，那就是包赚不赔的买卖！”
“眼下，我凤族五脉之子弟，血脉纯度越来越低，若是再得不到新鲜血液补充，那不出万年，必定要走龙族的老路。”
“此事，想必也不是白兄乐于见到的吧？”
“哼，这等大道理，用不着赤兄指点，在下也是知晓的。”
白袍修士冷哼了一声，然后接着道：“若是不知道此中危机，我又如何会将祖上流传的精血拿出如此之多？”
“刚才多问一句，不过是想听听青兄对此事，有多少把握罢了。”
“呵呵，两位兄弟无需多想。”
那位青袍修士此刻，终于搭上话了，“其实根据远古的记载，不管是我凤族五族，还是其他真灵，在各大界面之间，都能很轻易地游走的。”
“故而真灵后裔，在各大界面各处角落肯定都会有传播。”
“我五洲人界之中，虽然妖族大多都集中在东胜神洲，可中土圣洲、西牛贺洲甚至南瞻部洲，也都有分布。”
“尤其是南瞻部洲，其被放逐已有十余万年，若是能从此洲带回部分后裔，不管其修为高低、血脉纯度高低，对我东胜神洲凤族来说，都是新鲜的补充。”
“说不定，两大洲残存的凤族血脉互相融合之下，还能激发出深层的血脉之力。”
“这样一来，凤族五族便无需向龙族那般，自甘与牛龟狼豺等贱种杂交，以延续血脉了。”
“哈哈哈，青兄说的是。”
赤袍修士闻言哈哈一笑，又接着道：“其实与牛龟狼豺苟合倒也罢了，对那蟾蜍也能下得去手，当真是匪夷所思了……”
“哈哈哈……”众人闻言，皆是哈哈大笑。
content_en:
During his travels, Li Zhuoyang discovered that many low-level spiritual veins and even exhausted spiritual veins in Nanzhan Buzhou Continent were slowly recovering.
In the mortal realm, more and more young people with spiritual roots are being discovered.
Many people in the world of immortal cultivation in ordinary countries who could only cultivate to the ninth level of Qi Refining Realm have gradually begun to build foundations.
These changes certainly make Li Zhuoyang happy.
He even thought that maybe the distance between Nanzhanbu Continent and other continents was slowly getting closer.
…
In an unknown valley somewhere, a huge magic circle with a radius of one hundred feet was arranged.
Viewed from a high altitude, in addition to the large number of formation flags surrounding this formation, the one in the middle is actually a picture drawn with an unknown material.
And if you look closely, what is drawn in this picture is actually a portrait of the Feng Clan that combines all the characteristics of the five Feng Clan.
Around the magic circle, there were more than a dozen monks dressed in different clothes.
"Brother Qing, can we really find descendants of my Phoenix clan's blood in this magic circle?"
"You know, the amount of Phoenix Clan essence and blood collected from each bloodline this time is quite large. If the number of descendants transferred in the end is not large, or the purity of the bloodline is not enough, then this time it will be considered a loss-making deal."
The speaker was a man in white robes. As he spoke, his eyes seemed to be flashing with lightning, making people almost afraid to look directly into his eyes.
"Hey, Brother Bai, this is wrong..."
The man called Brother Qing did not speak, but the red-robed monk beside him responded first: "If this matter is treated as an ordinary business, it is not really a good deal."
"After all, no one can say for sure whether there are any descendants of the Phoenix clan among the Five Continents."
"But if this matter is regarded as a move to save the survival of our Phoenix clan, then it is a business that guarantees profit but no loss!"
"Right now, the blood purity of my descendants from the fifth lineage of the Phoenix Clan is getting lower and lower. If they can no longer get fresh blood to replenish their blood, they will definitely follow the old path of the Dragon Clan within ten thousand years."
"This must not be something Brother Bai would like to see, right?"
"Hmph, you don't need Brother Chi's guidance on such great principles. I already know them."
The white-robed monk snorted coldly, and then continued: "If I didn't know the danger, how could I take out so much of the blood essence passed down by my ancestors?"
"I just wanted to ask more, just to hear how sure Brother Qing is about this matter."
"Haha, you two brothers don't need to think too much."
At this moment, the green-robed monk finally struck up a conversation, "In fact, according to ancient records, whether it is our five Phoenix clans or other true spirits, they can easily travel between the major interfaces."
"Therefore, the descendants of true spirits will definitely be spread in every corner of all major interfaces."
"Among the human realms of our five continents, although most of the demon clans are concentrated in Dongsheng Shenzhou, they are also distributed in Zhongtu Holy Continent, Xiniuhe Continent and even Nanzhanbu Continent."
"Especially Nanzhanbu Continent, which has been exiled for more than 100,000 years. If we can bring back some descendants from this continent, regardless of their level of cultivation or blood purity, they will be a fresh addition to our Phoenix Clan of Dongsheng Shenzhou."
"Perhaps, when the remaining Phoenix bloodlines from the two continents merge with each other, they can also stimulate deep bloodline power."
"In this way, the five Feng Clan no longer need to be like the Dragon Clan, willing to cross with bulls, turtles, wolves, jackals and other lowly species in order to continue their bloodline."
"Hahaha, that's what Brother Qing said."
The red-robed monk laughed when he heard this, and then continued: "Actually, even if you can get along with a bull, turtle, wolf, and jackal, you can also kill that toad. It's really incredible..."
"Hahaha..." Everyone laughed when they heard this.
